summary: Five of six seats succeeded at effort high (kimi failed: its provider refused the request for quota). All five asked for revision; none blocked. Strongest agreement: amendment A14 cites the wrong prior wording (4 seats), the binding's name-collision rule still upper-cases every name (3), and some open-question dispositions are not final (3). Claude alone found that the size bound on the two new files is a second new failure of a default run, which predicate 2 denies. Gemini's high concern that names are unquoted in the semantic model is not shared by any other seat.

Codex calls it blocking, Claude hardening; GLM notes the stale code comment.
